card.name: Clumps and particles in mixed doses
card.fires_on: The end of words for lumps or particles (clumped, clumps, particles, agglomeration) or break-up words (apart, up) in mixing or reconstitution directions. It responds when the text describes the powder or suspension having clumps or solids.

modes.label: Lumps in a mixture
modes.description: The ending of clump or lump words when the directions say the mixture should be free of them.
modes.example: Check to make sure the powder is mixed (the mixture should look cloudy and free of cl<<umps>>).

modes.label: Particles and agglomeration
modes.description: Particle or agglomeration words describing solids in a suspension.
modes.example: stir the suspension with the same spoon to re-suspend any<< particles>> before administration.

modes.label: Breaking up solids
modes.description: Words like apart or up after break or loose, describing powder or pellets being broken up.
modes.example: a spoon may be used to break<< apart>> the powder.

card.writes: It adds words about solid bits, particles and sample-like matter, with no clear link among the suppressed tokens.
card.plain: It fires when preparation directions talk about lumps, clumps or particles in a powder or liquid mixture.
